text:
Hail, Queen of heaven,
hail, Lady of the angels;
hail, root, hail, gateway,
from which the Light of the world was born.
Rejoice, O glorious Virgin,
who surpasses all in beauty;
we greet you, O Virgin most fair,
entreat Christ our Lord for us.

V. Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.
R. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

Let us pray:
Grant, we beseech you, O Lord,
that we who have celebrated the mysteries
of the Lord's Resurrection,
may merit to attain through your grace
the joys of everlasting life.
Through the same Christ our Lord.
Amen.
latin:
Ave, Regina caelorum,
ave, Domina angelorum,
salve, radix, salve, porta,
ex qua mundo lux est orta.
Gaude, Virgo gloriosa,
super omnes speciosa,
ave, felix Virgo pudent,
ora pro nobis Dominum.

V. Ora pro nobis, sancta Dei Genetrix.
R. Ut digni efficiamur promissionibus Christi.

Oremus:
Concede, quaesumus, Domine nobis famulis tuis,
ut, qui mysteria mortis et resurrectionis
Domini nostri Iesu Christi celebramus,
ad perpetuam possimus beatitudinem pervenire.
Per eundem Christum Dominum nostrum.
Amen.
